# skycloak_realm_user (Resource)

A realm user. Grant roles with `skycloak_realm_user_role_assignment` and group membership with `skycloak_realm_group_membership`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_realm_user" "jdoe" {
  cluster_id         = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name         = skycloak_realm.app.name
  username           = "jdoe"
  email              = "jdoe@example.com"
  first_name         = "Jane"
  last_name          = "Doe"
  enabled            = true
  temporary_password = var.jdoe_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.
- `temporary_password` (String, Sensitive) Initial password (min 8 chars). Write-only; changing it recreates the user (there is no password-update endpoint).
- `username` (String) Username. Immutable.

### Optional

- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the email address is verified. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can sign in. Defaults to `true`.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `last_login_at` (String) Most recent sign-in (RFC 3339).
